reviews.review:
Highly Overrated, probably gonna be abandoned in a year.

Edit: Not abandoned but still overrated, mounts are still buggy and clunky, combat is still buggy and clunky, movement is still buggy and clunky and pretty much everything below still applies today.

Mount controls are horrendous and your pal never listens to you when you spam or hold f to get on and lets not talk about trying to dismount off the mfer 

The map is ok ig lots of lighting issues, clipping and Z fighting all over the map 

Havent really experienced any game breaking bugs other then hardly being able to mount 

Gameplay is pretty boring not really any story 

Single player worlds lag as if you are on multiplayer 

The pals are cool they have pretty interesting designs but I feel no strive to collect them all once you make a base you beat the game theres really nothing to do in this game, no story, no quests, no missions etc.

The trainer fights are just enemies that are bullet sponges and can be easily cheesed the boss pals in the different areas of the map actually feel more like a boss fight then the trainers 

Overall this game is pretty boring, tedious and doesnt have much going for it IMO, although it is still early access so many things can change but currently I dont think that much will change going forward as I feel like this game is just going to be abandoned later, I dont think it is worth the 30$ maybe buy it if it is on sale.

It's fun nut the breeding system needs some work, something like "Breeders Of The Nephelym" They have the trait system, the game also needs the skins between males and female Pals more defined, not a one skin fit's all thing, kind of makes it complicated for modders I guess, then the skins for both male and female Pals can be changed.
fun survival game. closer to ark or rust than pokemon. designs are cool and mostly unique

This game is a very fun "Pokemon-like" game that I've been looking for. It is an amazing single-player game, but when you play it with friends that's where it pops. It has everything you need for it to be a fun game to play with your friends, and it's only in beta! This made the most of my money, and I would recommend it to others.
